allow: PowerShell($ports = 3000,3001; foreach \($p in $ports\) { $conns = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $p -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($conns\) { foreach \($c in $conns\) { Write-Output "Port $p -> PID $\($c.OwningProcess\)"; Stop-Process -Id $c.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } } else { Write-Output "Port $p -> nothing listening" } })

PowerShell(Start-Sleep -Seconds 1; foreach \($p in 3000,3001\) { $c = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $p -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($c\) { Write-Output "Port $p still listening" } else { Write-Output "Port $p is free" } })
